Trees are some of our greatest teachers. They root down into the dark, turning decay into nourishment, while reaching up into the light. They witness everything and everyone, sometimes for centuries. They hold it all and keep things steady.

This month, the spirits have been teaching me about our ability to do the same: to be honest about what we see and feel, even when it's uncomfortable, and still find our center.

This month's Energy Medicine is a centering practice taught to me by the nature spirits called Tree Breathing. I hope you love it!

I've also chosen a few crystal allies to support you.

In many ancient cultures, the egg is revered as a powerful symbol of life, creation, and potential. It represents the beginning of all things and embodies the mysteries of birth, renewal, and transformation. The egg's smooth, unbroken shell signifies wholeness and unity, and symbolizes the essence of life's endless possibilities. Golden eggs are often associated with prosperity, abundance, and the sacred energy of the sun, bringing light, warmth, and growth into one's life.  Our golden egg talismans carry this rich heritage, symbolizing not only new beginnings, fertility, and wholeness, but also the energy required to manifest dreams into reality. By wearing one, you align with the power of this timeless symbol, inviting the ancient wisdom of creation and the promise of potential into your journey. Let it serve as a reminder of your natural ability to create, transform, and protect.
